resolutions: Diff pin: reuse product_tree_digest (index fingerprint, excludes .factory/+plans/) as the reviewed-diff binding; stamp==done proves shipped==reviewed. No bespoke diff-content digest.

Brief binding: bind brief_sha256 when a delegate launch/brief exists; otherwise the stamp still binds stage id + task_sha256 + baseline + tree digest, so non-delegated work can still stamp. No carve-out.
Bootstrap: task 4 records its own stage-local stamp (dogfood); no exemption code.

Implementation complete: the gate is in place (single shared stage_review_binding seam, not a fourth artifact) and the 27 existing stage-done/stage-start fixtures it broke were updated via a shared stamp_and_commit test helper. Full stage suite independently verified green (50 passed). required_tests kept as the 2 characterizing tests; the pre-existing regressions are enforced by the full suite/CI.
current_flow: stage done (_finish_stage) measures the diff and refuses an empty delta but requires NO local review stamp and does not force a fully-committed product tree. record_review only writes the three lens artifacts. product_tree_digest, product_tree_snapshot, changed_paths, stage_baseline, review_passed and the persisted brief (.factory/briefs/<id>.md, brief_sha256) already exist and are reused.

criteria_map.stage done refuses without a fresh stage: Inspected _finish_stage; the added gate refuses unless a fresh stamp (matching stage id/task_sha256/base_sha/brief_sha256 and product_tree_digest==current) exists, the product tree is fully committed, and the committed delta is non-empty (extends the existing empty-delta refusal).
criteria_map.the stamp is a stages.json token and rec: Inspected record_review + load_review_artifacts; --aspect stage-local writes the token into the active stages.json entry only, and closeout/load_review_artifacts still read exactly quality/performance/security (decision 0011).

new_abstractions: A stage-local stamp token in stages.json plus a shared derivation of its bindings in factory_lib; justified as the single seam both the recorder writes and stage done re-derives, and explicitly NOT a fourth review artifact.

rounds.question: Realize the pre-commit product diff digest how?
Brief-sha binding when a task ran without delegation?
Does task 4's own stage done require a stamp?

citations.finding: Review must remain ONE three-lens pass, never per-task review artifacts.
The composed brief is persisted at .factory/briefs/<id>.md with a brief_sha256 on the launch record, so the stamp can bind it.
